title: New Residential Construction (Building Permits, Housing Starts, Completions — September 2026 data) — 8:30 a.m. ET, the last solo GDPNow vintage of the 2026:Q3 nowcast
source: CENSUS: three independent census.gov primaries fetched direct 2026-09-06 by this event's own initial research, plus one non-Census corroboration. (1) economic-indicators/calendar-listview.html (HTTP 200, 91,396 bytes, 179 table rows parsed), row "New Residential Construction (Building Permits, Housing Starts, and Housing Completions) | October 20, 2026 | 8:30 AM | September 2026", release code A202610200830, reference A202609 — and it is the ONLY Census release on that date; the page's only four `Suspended` rows are Preliminary Steel Imports and the Advance Economic Indicators Report, not this series. (2) construction/soc/schedule.html, the Survey of Construction Release Schedule (HTTP 200, 59,625 bytes), whose row reads "September 2026 | October 20, 2026 | October 27, 2026" under the column heads "(12th Workday) New Residential Construction - 8:30 a.m." and "(17th Workday) Revised Building Permits - 8:00 a.m. / New Residential Sales - 10:00 a.m.". (3) construction/xls/historic_release_dates.xls (HTTP 200, 55,808 bytes, 514 reference months 1984-01 to 2026-11), row reference 2026-09 -> NRC 2026-10-20, NRS 2026-10-27. (4) The Atlanta Fed's GDPNowcastDataReleaseDates.xlsx PostedUpdates sheet (HTTP 200, 16,944 bytes), whose 2026-10-20 08:30 row reads "Housing starts" alone. Promoted `estimate` -> `confirmed` and `EST:` -> `CENSUS:` on the two-primary precedent this calendar already carries for durable-goods-2026-11-25, m3-full-report-2026-12-03 and the sibling housing-starts-2026-12-17. notes: Canonical file written by this id's own initial research (2026-09-06) after reading the single proposal `from-construction-spending-2026-11-02`, now shadowed. Three findings distinguish this edition from the sibling housing-starts-2026-12-17, which had declined 10-20 as "not distinguishable". (1) THE QUIET SLOT: this print's GDPNow vintage is POST-QUARTER (2026-10-20 sits 20 days past the 2026:Q3 quarter-end it nowcasts, and the 2026:Q4 initial nowcast does not open until 2026-10-29). Across 1,822 same-quarter deltas in `ContribArchives`, the 48 post-quarter housing-starts vintages move the residential contribution a median 0.0250pp against the 95 in-quarter ones at 0.0869pp — a 3.48x attenuation, p=0.0001 — so the corridor's headline 0.0609pp figure overstates this edition by ~2.4x. The gradient is starts-specific and survives its controls: all vintages pooled give only 1.42x (p=0.056), construction spending shows NO gradient at all (0.0632 vs 0.0596, p=0.879), and starts post-quarter still moves residential 5x harder than every other post-quarter vintage (0.0250 vs 0.0049, p=0.0001). (2) ATTRIBUTION IS PERFECT IN THIS SLOT, which is the compensation: the 2026-10-20 vintage is SOLO (unlike 12-17's, shared with import/export prices), and on the 35 post-quarter solo starts vintages residential is the largest of the eight component moves 35/35 = 100.0% against a 20.7% base rate; all 11 October starts vintages in the archive (2014-2024) are 11/11. (3) THE CLEAN INSTANCE: unlike 12-17 this date carries no confound worth naming — the 09-30 funding cliff was AVERTED (PL 119-103 funds through 2026-12-11, so no lapse can reach this print, and a lapse is the only thing that has ever moved this schedule: all 9 of 514 out-of-month slips since 1984 are lapse slips), October opex is four days earlier and release days 1-3 sessions past opex are null (ITB p=0.68), and there is no October release-day seasonal on any of ITB/XHB/SPY/QQQ once the month itself is controlled for. That makes 2026-10-20 the cleanest of the three dated chances the 12-17 ledger's own tape kill switch named. Impact LOW and symbols empty on measurement, not assumption: the homebuilder overnight-gap edge was real through 2015 and has been null for eleven years (ITB 2016-20 p=0.50, 2021-26 p=0.46, n=124), and no macro- or housing-keyed house playbook exists (`housing` re-grepped 2026-09-06 across trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md, 0 hits). Date `confirmed`; nothing here licenses an entry.
